prompt: Ingest the p_hacking.pdf paper into Research folder. Academic paper about p-hacking.

assertions.name: preserves_argument_structure
assertions.description: Has separate notes covering motivation, methods, and results (not everything in one note)

assertions.name: has_overview_note
assertions.description: Contains an overview note with research question, contribution, and key finding

assertions.name: enhanced_frontmatter
assertions.description: Notes have doc_type: paper, source_location, and depends_on in frontmatter

assertions.name: formal_results_stated
assertions.description: Key statistical results and findings are formally stated with numbers/equations, not just mentioned in passing

assertions.name: index_with_routing
assertions.description: Index file has routing summary directing readers to specific notes for specific concepts
